confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because Can Tho accommodation varies widely by district and season. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page. I did not open that page, and I could not independently confirm the 15 October 2026 figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced below Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang and in line with other mid-sized Vietnamese regional cities in the Mekong Delta and central Vietnam. Drink prices use the local beer relationship: cocktail is about 4x beer and wine glass about 5x beer.
